description: New synthetic preference-transfer cases, authored after the prompt was selected and before their first live run. The example adds a user filing preference absent from the baseline.

cases.text:
EMPLOYMENT CERTIFICATE
This certificate confirms that the employee works at the company. It is proof of employment.

rules.instruction: Keep employment certificates and employment contracts here.

Keep immigration applications and their supporting documents here.

## Filing example
Belongs here: Employment certificates from the Aster application source folder, kept with that application.
Does not belong here: An employment certificate with no application association.
